summary: Build PDF Magik, a browser-based PDF password tool. Users select a PDF, set and confirm an opening password, and download the protected copy while file processing remains local in the browser.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains repository documentation and planning artifacts but no application source, package manifest, or existing service to augment.

questions.rationale: The existing requirements artifact records TypeScript for this app.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: TypeScript with type safety for the browser application.

options.label: JavaScript

questions.question: Which frontend framework for PDF Magik Web App?

questions.question: Describe the features for PDF Magik Web App.
questions.answer: Let me select a PDF, enter and confirm an opening password, then download the password-protected PDF. Keep file processing local in the browser and do not upload documents.
questions.rationale: This feature description is recorded in the existing requirements artifact.
